title: Concept: Redirect via redirect_to (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, redirect_to issues a redirect to a caller-chosen address. Open targets let attackers craft trusted-looking links to hostile sites. The remedy is target validation via an allowlist of paths.
applicability: ruby request handlers redirecting through redirect_to; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Phishing and token theft via trusted-domain links; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when redirects carry tokens.
